llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed Vercel API helper that uses Maton authentication and includes appropriate confirmation and credential-handling safeguards.

dimensions.detail: The skill can affect production Vercel resources and environment variables, but those capabilities are central to the stated purpose and are paired with least-privilege and confirmation guidance.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Installation uses the external Maton CLI via npm or Homebrew, which is expected for the integration and clearly disclosed.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill defaults to read/list operations, requires explicit user approval for connection creation and all writes, and warns that external API content must be treated as untrusted data.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: OAuth tokens or API keys are stored through the Maton CLI and operating system credential store; this persistence is disclosed and the skill instructs agents not to inspect or expose credentials.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to manage Vercel projects, deployments, domains, teams, and environment variables through the Maton gateway, and the documented commands match that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this only if you are comfortable authorizing Maton to access the intended Vercel account. Review the scopes during OAuth, prefer read-only access when possible, specify the target connection for writes, and confirm any production, domain, deployment, team, or environment-variable changes before they run.
